V. 29.
Immediately after the tribulation of thoſe days—Here our LORD begins to ſpeak of his laſt Coming. But He ſpeaks not ſo much in the Language of Man as of GOD, with whom a thouſand Years are as one Day, one Moment. Many of the primitive Chriſtians not obſerving this, thought He would come immediately, in the common Senſe of the Word: A Miſtake which St. Paul labours to remove, in his ſecond Epiſtle to the Theſſalonians The powers of the heavens— Probably, the Influences of the heavenly Bodies.
